note: BH-9933 (BH-9926 wave 1): settings row lane.tickets-snapshot-push.gh_source. Where the lane reads each board repo's open PR list: off = GitHub only (pulls?state=open, today's read); shadow (default) = the PR record and GitHub, the lane uses GitHub and logs one PRR_SHADOW line in logs/prr-shadow.log when they differ; record = the PR record only, 0 pulls reads, and a record miss reads GitHub and logs PRR_MISS. Any other value is shadow plus one PRR_STEP line. Read by prr_step in bin/lib/prr-shadow.sh.
